text:
```yaml
name: Labeler

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened, edited, labeled, unlabeled, closed]
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, edited, labeled, unlabeled, closed]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  label:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      issues: write
      pull-requests: write
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Run labeler action
        uses: ./.github/actions/labeler
        with:
          # The action expects a required `taskId` input. Provide the issue or PR number.
          taskId: ${{ github.event.issue.number || github.event.pull_request.number }}
          # Add any other required inputs for your custom labeler action below.
          # For example:
          # config: .github/labeler.yml
```
